name: Providence Recreation Day Camps
description_short: All day summer camps run by the city at ten neighborhood recreation centers in Providence, including Igliozzi, Rollins and Kennedy. Camp runs 8:30am to 4pm for $5 a week, with free breakfast and lunch.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Eat Play Learn PVD 2026 page: day camps $5 a week per child, 8:30am to 4pm, free breakfast and lunch, early drop off 7:30 to 8:30am and late pick up 4 to 5pm for $5 each, no camp July 4 and August 11, registration from April 4 on RecDesk or at any center. Centers listed: Davey Lopes (227 Dudley St, 02907), John H. Rollins (674 Prairie Ave, 02905), Madeline Rogers (60 Camden Ave, 02908), Vincent Igliozzi (675 Plainfield St, 02909), Robert F. Kennedy (195 Nelson St, 02908), Sackett (159 Sackett St, 02907), Vincent Brown (438 Hope St), West End (109 Bucklin St, 02907), Zuccolo (18 Gesler St, 02909), Batastini (50 Obediah Brown Rd, 02909). No ages or start and end dates are given for the day camps

notes: One listing for the city's day camps. The page gives the same hours, price and meals for all ten recreation centers and no dates or ages for any of them, so the centers are listed in the source note rather than as separate camps.

source.title: Recreation Department Camps - Eat, Play, Learn PVD

warnings: The page says no camp on July 4, which was a Saturday in 2026; it may be carried over from an earlier year
